_comment: Provenance of test/fixtures/canonical-zebra-local.toml, the golden copy of the
config the project's canonical renderer produces for SwarmTestnet.
test/renderer-parity.test.js compares the app's own generator against that
fixture byte for byte, in CI, where the planning repository does not exist.
A second test re-renders with the real renderer when it IS present, and fails
if the fixture has gone stale.
2026-09-25: renderer gained an explicit testnet-only identity guard; source hash refreshed after manifest, rendered TOML and fixture hashes remained identical.
